## Usage guidance

- Pick by intent: surfaces from `--ds-color-surface-*`, text from `--ds-color-text-*`, actions from `--ds-color-accent-*`, status from `--ds-color-status-*`.
- Space tokens ONLY in margin/padding/gap/inset. Box dimensions use `--ds-size-control-*` / `--ds-size-icon-*`.
- Gap vs space steps: the `--ds-space-gap-{sm,md,lg}` trio (tops out at `gap-lg`) is for intra-component rhythm (icon-to-label, control clusters, sibling gaps); larger section- and region-level separation uses the plain space steps (`--ds-space-5` and up).
- Text on solid status fills is `var(--ds-color-text-inverse)` — there is no `text-on-danger` style token.
- Only foreground/background pairs present in registries/contrast-report.json are legal color combinations.
